name: Life gain and draining
description: Gain life and make your opponents lose it. White and black cards with lifelink, rewards for gaining life, drains when creatures enter or die, and a few ways to finish the game.

cards.name: Calvina, Mother of Tithes
cards.rule_text:
Lifelink
Whenever you gain life, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature you control.
Creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them have lifelink.
cards.flavor_text: Every gift to the chapel is repaid in kind.

cards.name: Morvenna, the Last Toll
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, each opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
At the beginning of your end step, if you gained life this turn, return up to one target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Chapel Bellwarden
cards.rule_text: Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.

cards.name: Vigil Acolyte
cards.rule_text:
Lifelink
When CARDNAME enters, you gain 2 life.
cards.flavor_text: She keeps the candles lit for those who never came home.

cards.name: Vesper Bat
cards.rule_text:
Flying, lifelink
Whenever you gain life, CARDNAME gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Choir of the Tolling Dark
cards.rule_text:
Flying
Whenever one or more other creatures you control enter, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Carrion Psalmist
cards.rule_text: Whenever CARDNAME or another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life.
cards.flavor_text: It sings for every soul that passes, friend or foe.

cards.name: Chronicler of Spilt Blood
cards.rule_text:
Lifelink
Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, you may pay {1}. If you do, draw a card.

cards.name: Herald of the Final Tithe
cards.rule_text:
Flying, lifelink
When CARDNAME enters, each opponent loses life equal to the number of creatures you control. You gain life equal to the life lost this way.

cards.name: Covenant of the Crimson Ledger
cards.rule_text:
Whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1 life.
At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 5 or more life this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: Every drop is written down. Every debt is collected.

cards.name: Mantle of Shared Blood
cards.rule_text:
Creatures you control have lifelink.
At the beginning of your end step, if you gained 10 or more life this turn, create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying.

cards.name: Candlelit Procession
cards.rule_text: Create three 1/1 white Cleric creature tokens with lifelink.
cards.flavor_text: They walk the old road every year, and every year there are more of them.

cards.name: Settling of Old Debts
cards.rule_text: Each opponent loses life equal to the amount of life you gained this turn. Draw a card.

cards.name: Verdict at Dusk
cards.rule_text: Destroy target creature. You gain life equal to its toughness.

cards.name: Siphoning Kiss
cards.rule_text: Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn. You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Requiem of the Pale Hour
cards.rule_text: Destroy all creatures. You gain 2 life for each creature destroyed this way.

cards.name: Shelter Beneath the Steeple
cards.rule_text: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. You gain 1 life for each creature you control.

cards.name: Altar of Quiet Offerings
cards.rule_text: {1}, Sacrifice a creature: You gain 2 life and scry 1.

cards.name: Silver Thurible
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {W} or {B}.
{2}, {T}, Sacrifice CARDNAME: You gain 3 life and draw a card.

cards.name: Chapel of the Long Vigil
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{3}, {T}: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
